# Summit Mergers

> Summit Mergers LLC is a boutique M&A brokerage representing owners of established, profitable service businesses ($2M–$50M in annual revenue) through a confidential sale. Sellers pay no fees upfront or at closing; brokerage economics follow customary purchaser-side practice.

Industries served include HVAC, access control and security, fencing, professional services, technology, healthcare services and manufacturing. Most transactions close within 3 to 6 months of engagement.

Contact: info@summitmergers.com · (845) 402-6614
